assumptions: Tỷ VND. Toy nhà sản xuất thiết bị giữ quyền kiểm soát implant ký gửi đến khi bệnh viện sử dụng. Giá vốn theo đơn vị consumed; sample không bán ghi marketing expense. Không VAT.

evidence.text: [Kho] 500 implants gửi ký gửi tại bệnh viện, cost 20 triệu/chiếc. Bệnh viện sử dụng 300 trong kỳ, đơn giá bán 35 triệu/chiếc. 200 còn ký gửi.
[Chương trình] Tặng 20 implants khác làm training samples, cost cũng 20 triệu/chiếc. Không nằm trong 500, không nghĩa vụ thanh toán.
[Billing] Sử dụng 300 được xác minh, toàn bộ invoice. Cash thu 8 tỷ, opening AR 1 tỷ. Không writeoffs.
[Expense] Sales overhead 1.2 tỷ, chưa bao gồm samples. Không tax hoặc khoản khác.
[Slide] Sales ghi 500 shipments là sales units.

qas.question: Calculate implant sales earned on documented consumption.
Find retained consignment inventory carrying amount.
Determine COGS of implants consumed by hospitals.
Find training-sample marketing expense.
Reconcile closing implant trade receivable.
Calculate operating contribution after sales overhead and samples.
Why does shipment of 500 implants not establish 500 sales?
qas.answer: Control remains with the producer until documented hospital consumption.

qas.question: Can utilization rate of all implants in the hospital be determined?
qas.answer: No. The case only reports this supplier's consignment and usage, not total hospital implant stock.

assumptions: Tỷ VND. Toy forwarder chịu loss obligation đối với khách được xác nhận; subrogation claim với carrier ghi riêng khi chấp thuận. Cash settlement không net vào gross recognized freight revenue.

evidence.text: [Dịch vụ] Freight forwarding revenue 90 tỷ, direct operating cost 62 tỷ, overhead 8 tỷ. All cash received/paid trước claim settlements.
[Claim] Khách có confirmed damage claim 12 tỷ. Forwarder trả 5 tỷ ngay; phần còn lại chưa trả. Không opening claim payable.
[Carrier] Carrier chấp thuận bồi hoàn 7 tỷ; đã trả 2 tỷ. Một yêu cầu thêm 3 tỷ còn tranh chấp, chưa ghi.
[Bảo hiểm] Không coverage hoặc recovery khác. Không tax.
[Báo cáo] Quản lý đề xuất giảm doanh thu 12 rồi cộng full 10 claim gửi carrier, mặc dù contract phân loại damage expense riêng.

qas.question: Find the acknowledged customer claim liability still unpaid.
Find the recognized carrier recovery receivable.
Find the net recognized loss from the damage event.
Calculate operating result after recognized damage and recovery.
Find net cash spent on claim settlements this period.
Determine total operating cash surplus including actual claim cash.
Why exclude the disputed additional carrier claim from recovery income?
qas.answer: It has not been accepted; the toy does not recognize the disputed amount.

qas.question: Can future customer claim frequency be estimated from one damage event?
qas.answer: No. Shipment counts and historical loss observations are missing.

assumptions: Tỷ VND. Toy prepaid data package allocated theo GB redemption, expiration được ghi breakage chỉ khi hết hạn chắc chắn. Các gói cùng giá/GB; rollover giữ nghĩa vụ.

evidence.text: [Top-up] Khách mua 1 triệu gói 20 GB giá 100 nghìn VND/gói. Total cash 100 tỷ; no opening balance.
[Usage] Tổng 20 triệu GB quyền sử dụng; 13 triệu GB đã dùng trong kỳ, 4 triệu rollover hợp lệ, 3 triệu hết hạn chắc chắn tại cuối kỳ.
[Policy] Ghi revenue theo mỗi GB quyền được sử dụng hoặc hết hạn; không estimate breakage trước hạn.
[Cost] Network variable cost 3 nghìn VND/GB actual used, fixed expense 20 tỷ.
[Dashboard] Sales gọi top-up cash 100 là service revenue; traffic system không ghi usage cho expired GB.

qas.question: Find allocated consideration per GB entitlement.
Find earned usage revenue for consumed data.
Find confirmed expiry revenue.
Find remaining service obligation for rolled-over GB.
Find actual traffic-related variable cost.
Calculate operating result including verified breakage.
Why is the rollover not breakage?
qas.answer: Those entitlements remain valid, so future service remains owed.

qas.question: Can monthly ARPU be calculated from package count alone?
qas.answer: No. Unique subscribers, renewal frequency and subscriber-months are absent.

assumptions: Triệu USD. Toy giao dịch không đủ điều kiện sale vì seller retains mandatory repurchase; ghi financing liability, giữ PPE. Interest cash thuộc financing expense. No tax.

evidence.text: [Giao dịch] Máy bay carrying 80, nhận tiền 100 từ financier. Điều khoản bắt buộc mua lại sau 5 năm; assessment toy xác định không chuyển control.
[Lịch] Trong năm đầu trả cash 12 gồm principal 7, interest 5. Không origination fee hoặc khoản khác.
[PPE] Remaining useful life 10 năm, straight-line, zero residual. Không impairment hoặc capex.
[KQKD] Operating revenue 60, other operating cost 35 trước depreciation và interest.
[Draft] Sales ledger ghi disposal gain 20 và loại PPE; không có valuation market độc lập.

qas.question: Find cash received at inception under the financing treatment.
Find year-end financing liability after principal repayment.
Find year-end aircraft carrying amount.
Calculate profit before tax after depreciation and interest.
Find disposal gain under the specified failed-sale model.
qas.answer: Zero; there is no sale recognition.

qas.question: Find net cash from financing arrangement before interest payment.
Why does 100 cash not justify derecognizing the aircraft?
qas.answer: Mandatory repurchase prevents transfer of control under the toy assessment; proceeds are borrowing.

qas.question: Can actual sale-and-leaseback treatment under another accounting framework be inferred?
qas.answer: No. The simplified case does not supply all contractual terms or framework requirements.

assumptions: Tỷ VND, nghìn tấn. Toy công ty thuê quota đánh bắt theo năm, fee cố định dù sử dụng thấp; chi phí quota expense toàn năm, không carryforward. Bán toàn bộ sản lượng thực tế.

evidence.text: [Quota] Thuê quyền 10 nghìn tấn với giá cố định 30 tỷ/năm. Không được rollover hoặc resale quota chưa dùng.
[Catch] Catch actual 7 nghìn tấn, price 18 triệu VND/tấn. Fuel/labor variable 10 triệu/tấn.
[Regulation] Penalty 2 tỷ do reporting delay đã xác nhận; không phải do đánh bắt vượt quota.
[Costs] Fixed vessel costs 12 tỷ, chưa gồm quota và penalty. All paid; no tax.
[Plan] Management giả định bán 10 nghìn tấn dựa quota và gọi 3 nghìn unused là inventory.

qas.question: Find earned catch sales revenue.
Find quota utilization rate.
Find actual variable fishing cost.
Calculate operating result after quota, vessel costs and penalty.
Find quota cost per actual tonne in million VND.
At unchanged price/cost, what incremental contribution would one additional thousand tonnes yield, assuming within quota?
qas.answer: 18−10=8 billion VND; fixed costs unchanged in the stated scenario.

qas.question: Why is unused quota not fish inventory?
qas.answer: Quota is an expiring permission; no fish were caught for the unused portion.

qas.question: Can sustainable catch level be established from the quota amount?
qas.answer: No. Biological stock and regulatory assessment details are absent.

assumptions: Tỷ VND. Toy housing và meal plan là nghĩa vụ riêng; housing earned theo tháng, meal plan theo suất dùng; security deposit refundable không revenue.

evidence.text: [Student contract] 1.000 students trả housing 24 triệu/người cho 12 tháng và meal plan 12 triệu/người cho 120 suất. Deposit 2 triệu/người ngoài giá.
[Delivery] Tại 31/12, đã ở 4 tháng, meal plan đã dùng 50.000 suất tổng cộng. Không expiry hoặc hủy.
[Cash] Tất cả tiền thu trước; no opening obligations. Housing cost 6 tỷ, meal cost .06 triệu/suất đã dùng.
[Policy] Mỗi suất meal có consideration .1 triệu; deposit hoàn đầy đủ nếu không damage. Không damage ghi nhận.
[Report] Bộ phận admissions gọi toàn bộ 38 tỷ cash là revenue năm.

qas.question: Find total advance cash from the student bundle and deposits.
Find earned housing consideration at month four.
Find meal-plan revenue on consumed meals.
Find outstanding service liabilities excluding refundable deposits.
Find total customer liabilities including deposits.
Calculate operating contribution from delivered housing and meals.
Why not include security deposits in earned housing revenue?
qas.answer: They are refundable obligations and no damage or forfeiture has occurred.

qas.question: Can student meal consumption in the next eight months be predicted?
qas.answer: No. Remaining entitlements do not specify actual redemption timing.

assumptions: Triệu USD, triệu tonnes. Toy current stripping cost allocate between ore produced and qualifying future-access asset based on specified verified volumes. Asset amortized only from next year. No tax.

evidence.text: [Hoạt động] Removal 12m tonnes waste, cost $3/t. Engineering verifies 8m tonnes support current ore extraction, 4m improve access to future ore body and qualify for asset.
[Sản xuất] Current ore 4m tonnes, all processed and sold; extraction cost ngoài stripping 20m, processing 15m.
[Revenue] Metal sales 90m. No byproduct, royalty hoặc inventory.
[PPE] Opening stripping asset 10m; amortization on old component 2m this year. New component not available until next year.
[Memo] Manager wants capitalize all 36m stripping because mining continues for years.

qas.question: Find total cash stripping cost incurred.
Find current production stripping expense.
Find qualifying future-access asset addition.
Reconcile closing stripping asset carrying amount.
Calculate operating result including current stripping and old amortization.
Find stripping cost expensed per current ore tonne, excluding old asset amortization.
Why not capitalize all waste removal?
qas.answer: Engineering identifies current production benefits separately; only future-access costs qualify in this toy.

qas.question: Can future component amortization be calculated by units of production?
qas.answer: No. Future recoverable ore units and extraction schedule are not supplied.

assumptions: Tỷ VND, triệu m³. Toy revenue actual verified consumption; estimated bills corrected by final meter readings. No VAT, bad debt or other price tiers.

evidence.text: [Billing] 2025 estimated billed volume 30 triệu m³, rate 8 nghìn VND/m³. Toàn bộ đã invoice theo estimate.
[Meter audit] Final meter readings xác nhận actual 28 triệu m³, including 2m³ million previously unmetered now captured in total 28. Do not add again.
[Credits] Utility issues credits for overbilling; opening AR 15 tỷ, cash received 210 tỷ, no write-off.
[Cost] Water produced 35 triệu m³; treatment cost 3 nghìn/m³ produced, fixed network cost 70 tỷ.
[Dashboard] Commercial team proposes 28+2=30 because it mistakes newly metered volume for incremental volume.

qas.question: Find original estimated billed revenue.
Find actual verified water revenue.
Find required customer billing credit.
Find ending receivable after meter correction.
Calculate treatment expense on produced water.
Calculate operating result after verified meter correction.
Why not add the newly metered 2m cubic meters to 28m?
qas.answer: The verified 28m already includes that volume; adding it duplicates consumption.

qas.question: Can physical leakage be separated from commercial loss?
qas.answer: No. Produced versus metered volume provides only an aggregate gap.
